bm_scorer.text: Cup Match! St George's against Somerset, two days, every August. Emancipation Day and Somers' Day, both public holidays.
It started in the early 1900s. It is cricket the way a wedding is a lunch: technically true, mostly not the point.

bm_barman.text: A Dark 'n' Stormy? Black rum and ginger beer, over ice, squeeze of lime. It's Bermuda's national drink, supposedly named for a cloud the colour of the rum.
I serve it in a glass. Some people use a bucket. Those people are from Surrey.
